app_name: Habit Builder: Don't Break The Chain
title: Stops tracking at day 19
body: I really like the simplicity of this app but it stops tracking the days at day 19, despite being able to tick the boxes. Would be great if this was resolved.
author: VictoriaM101

app_name: Habit Builder: Don't Break The Chain
title: Nice concept but faulty
body: Stopped updating my total after 19 days even though I can still tick the boxes
author: Mel6678

app_name: Habit Builder: Don't Break The Chain
title: Only Tracks One Single Goal
body: It appears to only allow one single goal at a time. I can appreciate the focus, but it’s not helpful when I need to keep track of three.
author: Wi5hfulThinking

app_name: Habit Builder: Don't Break The Chain
title: Does not go beyond 19 days!?
body: I love the simplicity of this app. However I do not understand why the current track will not go beyond 19 days. Every time I try to reset it by uninstalling and reinstalling I can only see my “progress“ up to 19 days. Once you tap 20th day or more it still says 19. Please fix! This makes the app useless.
author: SamuelBlair
